method: Globalping HTTPS GET with probe-side DNS and valid-TLS checks, using mainland eyeball-network ASN selectors plus a Singapore control. Different runs can select different probes. HTTP bodies may be truncated: response timings are not full downloads or browser page-load timings. An initial request to nonexistent 18qiufen.webp is excluded; the production asset is 16qiufen.webp. No authenticated gameplay was tested.
